description: This file contains the implementation of a concurrent load generator for testing distributed systems, including classes for reporting and managing load generation tasks.

classes.name: LoadGeneratorReport
classes.description: A struct for reporting load test metrics such as total requests, successes, failures, and duration.

classes.name: ConcurrentLoadGenerator`1
classes.description: A class that manages concurrent load generation with multiple worker tasks, tracking progress and generating reports.

methods.name: LoadGeneratorReport.ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the load report, including rate, successes, duration, and failures.

methods.name: ConcurrentLoadGenerator`1.Warmup
methods.description: Performs warmup requests before actual load testing begins.

methods.name: ConcurrentLoadGenerator`1.ResetBetweenRuns
methods.description: Resets the internal channel used for tracking completed work blocks.

methods.name: ConcurrentLoadGenerator`1.Run
methods.description: Executes the load test, managing worker tasks and collecting performance data.

methods.name: ConcurrentLoadGenerator`1.BuildReport
methods.description: Builds a summary report from collected work blocks.

methods.name: ConcurrentLoadGenerator`1.RunWorker
methods.description: Performs the work of issuing requests and recording results for a worker.
